name: prune dominated columns, then recurse on the even rows to find all row maxima
mechanism: in a matrix whose row-maximum positions never move left as you go down, first delete columns that can hold no row maximum (a stack pass comparing adjacent columns), then solve recursively on the even rows and fill the odd rows by scanning only between their neighbours' answers; total work linear in the dimensions

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'SMAWK Algorithm' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Linear algebra:

fails_when: the monotonicity condition is the whole assumption; it is not checked
